token_overhead_patterns.small_context_sdi_bloat: scenarios 21,24,26,28 show negative token reduction (prompt grows) when sdi_packet is selected on small contexts

failure_cases.name: research_handoff
failure_cases.root_cause: exact_tool_question regex matches 'exact license' even though question is self-contained; sdi_packet adds overhead
failure_cases.fix: Add tiny question gate: if raw question < 15 words and no risk flags, route to no_packet

failure_cases.name: constraint_trap
failure_cases.root_cause: exact-tool sdi_packet formats output as structured fields instead of natural 'No, never' answer; hard constraint already in raw context
failure_cases.fix: Add hard constraint gate: if hard constraints exist and question asks for action recommendation, prefer no_packet

failure_cases.name: open_loop_continuation
failure_cases.root_cause: sdi_packet framing with 'Expected evidence:' 'Pinned facts:' headers breaks natural conversational continuation flow
failure_cases.fix: Add open-loop continuation gate: if question asks to resume/continue/next step, prefer recent_only over sdi_packet

recommended_next_phase: Phase 26V-A: targeted policy refinement for 3 failure cases (tiny question gate, hard constraint gate, open-loop continuation gate). OR Phase 26V-B: consolidate v0.1 results if policy refinement not pursued.
